<!--
  Jura Trace is forensic-verification software. Bug reports without a
  working reproducer cannot be triaged reliably and will be closed with
  a request to add one. This is not a courtesy filter — without a
  reproducer the maintainer cannot tell whether the issue is real,
  whether a fix would address it, or whether a regression test will
  catch it. AI-generated bug reports without a working reproducer are
  routinely closed.
-->

## Environment

- **Jura Trace version:** <!-- Settings → About → Version -->
- **OS + version:** <!-- e.g. macOS 14.5, Windows 11 23H2, Ubuntu 22.04 -->
- **Hardware:** <!-- e.g. Apple M2, Intel x86_64 -->
- **Sidecar status:** <!-- Settings → Service Status → Analysis Engine: Online / Offline -->

## Logs / screenshots

<!-- Attach logs from Settings → Logs export, or screenshots showing the
     problem. For deepfake-detection issues, include the full Verify

## AI-tool use disclosure (only if applicable)

     Copilot, etc.), please say so. Reports that look LLM-generated and
     lack a working reproducer are routinely closed without further
     investigation. -->

- [ ] This report was written by a human, optionally with AI assistance
      for clarity (with a working reproducer that the human verified)
- [ ] This is an AI-generated report (note: will not be triaged without a
      verified reproducer)
